name: GitHub Copilot CLI
desc: Agentic coding from the terminal, with your choice of model.
desc_zh: 在终端里做 Agent 编程，模型可以自己选。
solves: A coding session that needs the shell keeps dragging you back to the editor. The CLI stays in the terminal and extends through MCP, plugins and skills.
solves_zh: 需要动 shell 的编码会话会不断把你拽回编辑器。CLI 留在终端里，并通过 MCP、插件和技能扩展。
best_for: You live in the terminal and want the agent there too.
best_for_zh: 你一天都待在终端里，也希望 Agent 就在这个地方干活。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — GitHub Changelog, https://github.blog/changelog/2026-02-25-github-copilot-cl）。 Before the discovery window but missing from the ledger partition list, so proposed under rule (b). Distinct from Codex CLI, which the ledger has under the openai vendor. 首次公开日期来源：https://github.blog/changelog/2026-02-25-github-copilot-cli-is-now-generally-available/
